description: Primary target-domain evaluation reported in the paper: Google News, whole-document reading, no adaptation

corpus.source: Third-party news text collected through Google News
corpus.availability_note: The exact snapshot is verified and retained by the maintainers. Its full text is not redistributed until the underlying rights holders grant redistribution permission.

evaluation.test_aggregation: every leading test document read whole, each from its tokenizer's own beginning-of-document token; overlapping windows, each token scored once; the beginning-of-document token never scored
evaluation.note: the first test documents of the 80/10/10 split up to 6,000,000 UTF-8 bytes; identical bytes for every model

contamination.interpretation: conservative risk screening; perturbation preferences are not proof of memorization
